effect_size: paired difference in z units, reported in ablation_results.tsv (delta_vs_B0)
confidence_interval: Student-t 95% on the blank mean propagated onto z (mrdz.score.z_interval)
reason: Protocol v1.0 §17: the three replicates at a level are subsamples of one library, not independent samples. FIND-0018/EV-0038 measured that the pseudo-blank spread understates between-library spread by more than an order of magnitude, in the permissive direction. A p-value on n=3 pseudo-replicates would have a denominator known to be wrong. The benchmark decides on the preregistered consistency rule S1-S4 plus interval reporting. No p-value is computed, so none can be selected after the fact.
